name: Waterspring Field
summary: At Waterspring Field in northern Tanaris, stolen pumps leave Gadgetzan without water.

sections.title: A Stolen Oasis
sections.body: Beneath the Tanaris sands, pumps draw water for Gadgetzan. The Steamwheedle Cartel goblins built them to supply their growing trade hub. Now the Wastewanders hold the field. These human outlaws and desert marauders guard the pumps, while Gadgetzan seeks hired blades to reclaim its water.

faq.q: Who built the water towers here?
faq.answer: Gadgetzan's goblins built the towers to pump fresh water from deep underground reserves for their desert settlement and industry.

faq.q: Why are there bandits squatting at Waterspring Field?
faq.answer: The Wastewanders seized the pumps for themselves. Control of northern Tanaris's fresh water gives them power over nearby travelers and merchants.

faq.q: Why doesn't Gadgetzan take the field back directly?
faq.answer: Gadgetzan hires adventurers to drive off the Wastewanders and recover its water pouches. Why its Bruisers do not enter the field is unknown.

angles.text: The goblins' pumping towers show how they draw water beneath the desert sands.
As a human, you share your race with many Wastewander bandits who occupy the towers. They left the northern kingdoms to make a harsh life in the desert.
